title: 1. PROBLEM: Traditional Pen-and-Paper Notation is Slow and Inefficient

text: 1. PROBLEM: Traditional Pen-and-Paper Notation is Slow and Inefficient
textPreview: 1. PROBLEM: Traditional Pen-and-Paper Notation is Slow and Inefficient

name: TextBox 3
text:
The Coaching Bottleneck
• Coaches are distracted by manually writing tallies, losing valuable face-time with players.
• No immediate statistics can be calculated during the critical 11-point break or between sets.
• Paper records are easily lost, unorganized, and fail to track player progress over time.
• Existing commercial tech options are locked behind heavy subscription and equipment walls.
textPreview: The Coaching Bottleneck | • Coaches are distracted by manually writing tallies, losing valuable face-time with players. | • No immediate ...

name: Rounded Rectangle 4
text:
THE MANUAL CHAOS WE ARE ELIMINATING:
❌ Tally Marks on Paper
   Messy handwriting that coaches must count and calculate by hand after games.
❌ Zero Real-Time Action
   Insights arrive too late (usually days after a match) to adjust ongoing game strategies.
❌ Fragile & Lost Data
   Physical binders that pile up and offer no historical progress search capability.
textPreview: THE MANUAL CHAOS WE ARE ELIMINATING: | ❌ Tally Marks on Paper |    Messy handwriting that coaches must count and calculate by hand after ...

text: Highlight that traditional paper-based notation limits real-time tactical adjustments. Coaches cannot calculate percentages on the fly during a tight 11-point break, making raw tallies useless in the moment.

name: TextBox 1

name: Rounded Rectangle 3
text:
100% Bring Your Own Device (BYOD)
✔ Hardware Cost = RM0: Runs on iOS and Android smartphones or tablets already owned by coaches and players.
✔ No expensive high-speed cameras, smart rackets, or sensor devices to buy or calibrate.
✔ Extremely lightweight app install size that fits on older devices with low storage.
✔ Runs seamlessly in offline mode, auto-syncing to the database once a Wi-Fi connection is detected.
textPreview: 100% Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) | ✔ Hardware Cost = RM0: Runs on iOS and Android smartphones or tablets already owned by coaches and pl...

name: Rounded Rectangle 4
text:
Simple & Scalable App Architecture
☁ Mobile App (Frontend)
   Optimized React Native app that ensures ultra-smooth UI tapping response and zero button lag during rapid badminton rallies.
☁ Cloud Server & Database (Backend)
   Stat tallies are compressed and sent as small text files to the cloud, ensuring lightning-fast uploads with extremely low data usage.
☁ Web Dashboard (Alternative View)
   Allows academy administrators to print beautifully formatted PDF summaries and progress charts from any desktop browser.
textPreview: Simple & Scalable App Architecture | ☁ Mobile App (Frontend) |    Optimized React Native app that ensures ultra-smooth UI tapping respons...

text: Emphasize to the judges that the technology is highly feasible because we rely on React Native (runs everywhere) and simple databases. No hardware issues to debug, ensuring the product can launch in weeks, not years.

name: TextBox 3
text:
How We Scale Profitably
💰 Freemium Mobile App
   The basic notation and live scorecard app are 100% free for everyone. This guarantees rapid downloads and viral organic growth among clubs.
💰 Premium Academy Dashboard
   SaaS subscription model charging small private academies and leagues for bulk player analysis, PDF reports, and advanced team stats.
💰 In-App Sponsorships
   Premium brand placements from Malaysian sports equipment brands targeting active badminton enthusiasts directly on the scorecard UI.

name: Rounded Rectangle 4
text:
Key Market Strengths
📈 Huge Target Base in Malaysia
   Badminton is one of the most widely played sports in Malaysia with thousands of schools and private training courts active nationwide.
📈 Sifar Overhead (RM0 Inventory)
   No manufacturing costs, no physical inventory, no delivery logistics, and extremely low server maintenance fees.
📈 Global Scalability
   Easily translated into English, Chinese, and other languages to enter massive Asian markets like Indonesia, Thailand, and China instantly.
